newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson sees price pressure continuing.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees price pressure continuing.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company LM AB Ericsson said on Tuesday that it saw signs of similar price pressures on all products in 1997 as it experienced in 1996.
"I would not be surprised if it was about the same as last year," Ericsson's deputy managing director CW Ros told a news conference after the company released its 1996 earnings.
"We have no signs that point to anything else."
Ros pointed out that every forecast on price development was very uncertain.
Price pressure on Ericsson's products in 1996 was about in line with the company's own forecasts with the exception of mobile telephones, which was somewhat less than expected.
